name: Claude Mention Workflow

on:
  issues:
    types: [commented]
  pull_request:
    types: [review_requested, review_request_removed, commented]

jobs:
  check-mention:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests
  
      - name: Check for Claude mention
        id: check_mention
        run: |
          import os
          import requests
          
          comment_body = github.event.comment.body.lower()
          if "claude" in comment_body:
              print("Claude mentioned!")
              exit(0)
          else:
              print("Claude not mentioned.")
              exit(1)
        
      - name: Run script if Claude mentioned
        if: steps.check_mention.outputs.exit_code == 0
        run: |
          # Add your script logic here
          echo "Running script because Claude was mentioned."
